question: If sqrt {0.03 times 0.3 times p} = 0.3 × 0.03 × sqrt q , then (p)/(q) is:
solution:
**Given:**

√(0.03 × 0.3 × p) = 0.3 × 0.03 × √q

**Formula used:**

Square both sides to remove the square root:

**Calculation:**

Square both sides:

(0.03 × 0.3 × p) = (0.3 × 0.03 × √q)²

⇒ 0.03 × 0.3 × p = 0.09 × 0.0009 × q

⇒ 0.009p = 0.000081q

Divide both sides by q:

⇒ p ÷ q = 0.000081 ÷ 0.009

⇒ p ÷ q = 0.009

**∴ The value is 0.009.**
